episodes.synopsis: Piña holds a party to advance peace negotiations. Seeing the JSDF’s power, the senators choose peace. Just then, the pro-war Prince Zorzal arrives.
episodes.title: The Banquet Begins

episodes.synopsis: After an earthquake strikes the Imperial Capital, Piña brings Itami and the others to meet Emperor Molt. However, they are joined by Prince Zorzal.
episodes.title: The Imperial Capital Quake

episodes.synopsis: Itami rejects a mission from Yanagida to exterminate the Fire Dragon. Yao tells Tuka that the dragon killed her father, but she refuses to accept it.
episodes.title: Tuka Luna Marceau

episodes.synopsis: Itami heads to Elbe with Tuka, Lelei and Yao to destroy the Fire Dragon. When General Hazama learns of this mission, he prepares battle support.
episodes.title: The Fire Dragon, Once More

episodes.synopsis: Heavily armed, Itami and the others head to the Fire Dragon’s nest in the Tuba Mountains. Rory sees the dragon in the distance as they set explosives.
episodes.title: Decisive Battle

episodes.synopsis: Itami and the others finally defeat the Fire Dragon and save Tuka from her trauma. After being punished, Itami receives new orders.
episodes.title: The Magic City of Rondel

episodes.synopsis: Emperor Molt collapses at a ceremony and Prince Zorzal declares that he will lead the Empire. A sage named Mimoza tells Itami the secrets of the Gate.
episodes.title: Dangerous Sisters

episodes.synopsis: Prince Zorzal suppresses political opposition by arresting anti-war senators. Itami and the others hide after an attempt on Lelei’s life.
episodes.title: Lover

episodes.synopsis: A state official visits the Prime Minister to bolster peace. Itami and the others visit Rondel, home of the Magic Academy, for Lelei to take a test.
episodes.title: Deadline

episodes.synopsis: Zorzal’s Imperial Army and the Rose Knights wage an intense battle. Itami learns of an assassination plot as Lelei’s exam approaches its end.
episodes.title: The Empress in Slave's Clothing

episodes.synopsis: The JSDF aims to save the Japanese people and pro-peace nobles. Itami rushes to the Imperial Capital after hearing of Piña’s imprisonment.
episodes.title: Paradrop

episodes.synopsis: Itami and the 3rd Recon Unit head to the Imperial Palace to save Piña and the Emperor. However, Prince Zorzal is waiting for them with a giant Orge.
episodes.title: Thus They Fought
